messages:
emily_devex: Heads up — community reported intermittent disconnects in ruby sampleapp stream when tokens rotate mid-session.

matt_engineer: Yep reproduced locally. Streaming connection gets a 401 and the SDK raises instead of attempting a short reconnect.

olivia_reviewer: Do we have a CI trace? sounds similar to some other auth refresh edgecases but might be specific to streams.

ci-bot: [CI] job 5678 failed: sampleapp_stream_spec.rb — Net::HTTPBadResponse: "401 Unauthorized"

matt_engineer: Minimal repro: start long-running stream, trigger token refresh, subsequent frame receives 401 and client closes. Go SDK will transparently reconnect; ruby currently bubbles an error.

jordan_oncall: Is reconnecting safe? apps expect either resumable streams or explicit resume semantics. worth making opt-in.

matt_engineer: Proposal: add config option stream_reconnect_on_401 = true. Behavior: on first 401, try refresh once, reopen stream preserving X-Stream-Id header; if still failing, raise.

olivia_reviewer: Sounds reasonable. Add unit test that simulates 401 then 200 from auth endpoint, and an integration test for reset header preservation. Also ensure we log at debug not warn.

sam_doc_writer: If we ship this we should update quickstart with guidance for long-lived streams and token rotation. Suggest example snippet.

matt_engineer: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1024 — implements single reconnect on 401 and adds stream_reconnect_on_401 option.

ci-bot: [CI] running matrix for PR 1024

ci-bot: [CI] macOS runner flaked on unrelated paint test — requeued

ci-bot: [CI] sampleapp_stream_spec.rb passed on run 5678.3 ✅

emily_devex: Great, can we also add a short note in the SDK changelog and a snippet in quickstart?

matt_engineer: Yep will add changelog entry and quickstart blurb. Draft example:

sam_doc_writer: Nice example I can paste in docs:

sam_doc_writer: ```ruby
# enable single reconnect on 401 for long-lived streams
client = Redwood::Client.new(stream_reconnect_on_401: true)
stream = client.open_stream(resource: 'chat') do |frame|
  puts frame.text
end
```

olivia_reviewer: Left one minor nit in PR about test timeout and one logging level tweak. Otherwise LGTM.

jordan_oncall: Filing follow-up to track resumable offsets vs simple reconnect semantics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/issues/1026

matt_engineer: Thanks all, merging when green. Will coordinate docs update with sam.
